sources.entry: KubeStellar Console - Open-source multi-cluster Kubernetes dashboard with an MCP server (kc-agent) that enables AI coding agents to query and manage clusters via natural language. Integrates with 20+ CNCF projects for AI-assisted operations across edge and cloud.
KubeStellar Console | Multi-cluster Kubernetes dashboard with real-time observability

summary.one_liner: A self-hostable, AI-assisted multi-cluster Kubernetes dashboard with guided install missions for 250+ CNCF projects, bridged to clusters by a local kc-agent daemon.
summary.what_it_does: KubeStellar Console is a web dashboard for viewing and operating Kubernetes clusters, with real-time WebSocket event streaming from connected clusters. It offers guided "missions" that walk through installing CNCF projects with pre-flight checks, validation, troubleshooting, and rollback. A companion local daemon, kc-agent, forwards browser requests to kubeconfig contexts and to AI providers, and exposes an MCP bridge (kubestellar-ops and kubestellar-deploy) for querying cluster state. AI features are optional: with no supported provider configured, the console falls back to rule-based behavior. The README also describes Stellar, an alpha persistent-mission runtime with memory, event triggers, and audit trails. A hosted demo at console.kubestellar.io uses canned data and cannot reach a local kc-agent, so connecting to real clusters requires self-hosting.
use_cases: Monitor multiple Kubernetes clusters from one dashboard
Install CNCF projects with guided, step-by-step missions
Let AI coding agents query pods, deployments, and events via MCP
Evaluate the Kubernetes console UI with demo data
Run a Kubernetes dashboard in air-gapped or local-LLM environments
Track GitHub Actions pipelines and community activity alongside clusters
how_to_run: curl -sSL | bash  (start.sh: downloads pre-built console and kc-agent, starts both, opens the UI)
brew tap kubestellar/tap && brew install kc-agent  (macOS)
mkdir -p bin && go build -o bin/kc-agent ./cmd/kc-agent && ./bin/kc-agent  (from source, Go 1.26.4+)
./deploy.sh  (run the console inside a cluster; see docs/deploy.md)
notable: Guided install missions for 250+ CNCF projects, with pre-flight checks and rollback
kc-agent local bridge exposing an MCP server for AI coding agents to act on clusters
Works with local/self-hosted LLMs such as Ollama and Open WebUI for air-gapped use
Community marketplace for dashboards, card presets, and themes
Experimental Stellar runtime for persistent, event-driven operational missions (alpha)
caveats: The hosted demo at console.kubestellar.io cannot reach a local kc-agent; connecting to your own clusters requires self-hosting
Stellar is alpha/experimental and its architecture and APIs may change
Upstream API keys (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini) do not enable kc-agent tool-executing missions in the current build; CLI-based or local providers are needed
